close_reason: ClosureHandler moved to jmap-server, re-exported by domain crates
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs and crate-jmap-chat-server/src/lib.rs both define an identical ClosureHandler<B> struct plus its JmapHandler<C> impl, differing only in the bound (MailBackend vs ChatBackend). This is copy-paste shared infrastructure. The idiomatic fix is to move ClosureHandler into jmap-server as a generic type parameterized by trait bound (e.g. ClosureHandler<B: Send + Sync + 'static>), exporting it for both crates to use. Duplication means any future change (e.g. forwarding CallerCtx) must be made in both places.
title: ClosureHandler duplicated identically in mail-server and chat-server lib.rs
